integrity: Analytical proof plus an exact-rational standalone checker; finite calculations are not used to establish the infinite theorem. Bibliographic claims are limited to sources specifically inspected.
scientific_limitations: One-season probability of a strict majority, not asymptotic population growth, geometric mean fitness, or establishment over multiple generations.
Exactly two equally likely common environment states with the high and low survival probabilities exchanged between phenotypes.
Conditionally independent survival indicators and odd cohort size of at least three; arbitrary quorums, even cohorts, unbalanced states or imperfect mirrors are outside the theorem.
Priority relative to all historical Poisson-binomial and decision-theory literature has not been independently certified.
title: A universal viability boundary for majority-quorum diversification in mirrored environments
